html:
SMTO-TSK-0045 — This step is on hold while the task waits

GUID: 35ac466e-fcda-46db-bc18-0c5add6f89be
Slug: run-waiting
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • The task is waiting for something, often your answer or approval, or a background job, so this step didn't start and changed nothing.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the task and read its latest message to see what it is waiting for. This step was held back only because the task is waiting on something else.
  2. If it is asking you a question or for approval, answer it or use its approval buttons. Once you respond, the task can move on to its next steps.
  3. If it is waiting for a background job or event, let that finish; the task continues on its own. A waiting task carries on by itself when what it needs arrives.

What success looks like

  • The task leaves its waiting state and continues working.

If it still fails

  • If the task stays waiting with nothing for you to answer, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend your original message to push it along; that creates a second task.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The activity worker could not start a non-dependency activity because the run is in a waiting state (user input, approval, job or event) and recorded an unexecuted result.

What this means

  • The activity worker cannot start a non-dependency activity because the run is waiting; dependency nodes instead remain pending in their graph. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • The activity worker cannot start a non-dependency activity because the run is waiting; dependency nodes instead remain pending in their graph.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the current interaction/wait condition and the activity's unexecuted receipt.

How to fix it

  • No corrective action is required for this informational outcome.
  • Inspect the run's current wait (waiting_user, awaiting_confirmation or awaiting_clarification, waiting_job, waiting_event) and resolve it through its own control; normal admission then decides later work. Do not turn this status into an automatic retry or a new execution request.

Retry and execution caution

  • This state requests no new execution or automatic retry. Inspect the current task controls and retained results.

How to verify the fix

  • The existing wait resolves through its supported owner and normal admission decides subsequent work.

What not to do

  • Do not turn this status into an automatic retry or a new execution request.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
